import pytest
import click
from click._utils import UNSET
from click.core import Command, Option
from click.shell_completion import FishComplete

def test_multiline_help_text_fish_completion():
    @click.command()
    @click.option(
        "--at",
        "--attachment-type",
        type=(str, str),
        multiple=True,
        help="\b\nAttachment with explicit mimetype,\n--at image.jpg image/jpeg",
    )
    def cli():
        pass

    ctx_args = {}
    prog_name = "cli"
    complete_var = "COMPLETE"
    instruction = "fish_complete"

    comp = FishComplete(cli, ctx_args, prog_name, complete_var)
    completions = comp.complete()

    assert "Attachment with explicit mimetype,\n--at image.jpg image/jpeg" in completions
